name: treeix
description: The AI coding workspace: review AI agent changes across git worktrees, pull requests and terminal sessions in one place
author: zaxovaiko

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
scripts.dist:dmg: bun run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.dist:dmg:notarized: bun run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:mas: bun run build && electron-builder --mac mas --publish never
scripts.release:mac: bun run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.postinstall: chmod +x node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-*/spawn-helper && node-gyp rebuild -C native/mac-window && sh scripts/dev-app-name.sh
